company.name: Momo Medical
company.shortDescription: Momo Medical develops an IoT-equipped bed sensor that helps nurses track their elderly patients.
company.description: Momo Medical develops an app for nurses in memory care that helps them track their patients during the night. Their app shows an overview of all the live information that a nurse needs during the nightshift. The Momo App allows nurses to make fast decisions so they can be at the right place at the right time. As a result, being 30% more productive and at the same time improving the night rest of their residents. The majority of these insights are provided with a patented sensor below the mattress.

productsAndServices.description: An application linked to an IoT bed sensor that provides caregivers with real-time insights about elderly residents' bed status to improve patient monitoring and safety.

aiResearchSummary.text: Momo Medical is researching and developing a monitoring device configured to be associated with a support, such as a bed, to monitor the presence of a subject. The device includes a sensor for collecting data on the presence of the subject and a network gateway for connectivity, as described in 'Monitoring device, assembly of said monitoring device with a support, and ...'. Their work focuses on sensor-based presence detection and network-enabled monitoring for patient care environments.
